vulnerability.explanation: When printing namespace nodes, ns->prefix is passed to fprintf with "%s" without a NULL check. For default namespaces, ns->prefix can be NULL, causing fprintf to dereference a NULL pointer. This is reachable by supplying an XPath that selects namespace nodes (e.g., /*/namespace::*).
